(()=>{PT8._to=true;PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:19,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[],trackRace:true});const T=RACE.T;const ms=[];RACE.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&/^ct_/.test(o.name))ms.push(o)});RACE.scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);const rc=new THREE.Raycaster();let n=0,sink=0,sinkMax=0,big=0;for(let i=0;i<T.N;i+=1){const s=Math.sin(T.psi[i]),co=Math.cos(T.psi[i]),hw=T.hw[i];for(let l=-hw-1.5;l<=hw+1.5;l+=.3){if(Math.abs(l)<hw-2.5)continue;const x=T.x[i]+co*l,z=T.z[i]-s*l;rc.set(new THREE.Vector3(x,T.y[i]+6,z),new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0));rc.far=12;const hit=rc.intersectObjects(ms,false).find(h=>h.object.material&&h.object.material.map&&/road|kerb|tarmac/i.test(h.object.name));if(!hit)continue;const sh=T.surf(x,z,T.y[i]+1).h;n++;const d=hit.point.y-sh;if(d>.05){sink++;sinkMax=Math.max(sinkMax,d)}if(d>.15)big++}}return 'samples '+n+' visual above physics >5cm: '+sink+' >15cm: '+big+' max '+sinkMax.toFixed(2)+' names '+[...new Set(ms.map(m=>m.name))].filter(n=>/road/i.test(n)).join(',')})()
